name: HOOK
thought: Need to show off this new angle before I pass out from zero energy.

wants.item: A spot where the espresso can freeze solid for a cool trick
A branch that won't slide when I'm heavy with caffeine
A branch that grips like iron even when I'm full
Toothpick sharp enough to carve a map of the grove
A branch that doesn't slip when I hang upside down
Toothpick sharp enough to carve a path through the canopy
A branch thick enough to support a heavy espresso cup
A view angle where the crystal doesn't flicker
A branch sturdy enough for a backflip landing
Toothpick sharp enough to cut this espresso

diary.line: Checked out the islet's hut, tossed the coffee cup in the hammock, and claimed the telescope with my tail loop. The world looks smaller from here, perfect for showing off without l
Swung onto that low branch in the grove, hooked the tail around a palm, and tried to hold a pose while chewing.
Dropped the toothpick into the water and did a loop de loop with my tail just to see if it floats back up.
Sipped the espresso while watching the ants below, they look like static on a bad signal. My tail is doing loops in the air just for fun.
Bounced on that floating rock just for balance. The crystal above blinks back at me, finally getting a clear shot of my own flex.
Dropped the toothpick on the islet sand and spun it in a perfect circle while looping my tail over the telescope.
Stuck the toothpick in the arcade cabinet's crack, testing if it can hold my tail loop while I bounce off the neon sign.
Burnt tongue but the burn fixes my grip on this cup like glue, perfect for hanging out without dropping anything.
Grove smells like ripeness and regret. Grabbed a bunch, tail loops tight around the stem like a noose made of sugar.
The wind tried to shake me off, but my tail held the pose tighter than my grip ever could. Still better than just chewing fruit.
The floating stone under me is cracking; finally swapping this unstable perch for the sturdy tree branch below where I can actually grip without wobbling.
Woke up on the islet with a fresh cup. The rope bridge is wobbly but my tail can hold it just fine.
